messages.author: d3dd14373034b2c4
messages.subject: Installing on R 2.8.1
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to install aroma.affymetrix on R 2.8.1 (and the
Bioconductor version that goes with it).
After a long and tedious process of downloading missing packages, I'm
stuck at the following:
Error: package 'R.huge' 0.1.5 was found, but >= 0.1.6 is required by
'aroma.affymetrix'

Is it possible to install aroma.affymetrix on R 2.8.1 using the
versions of Bioconductor packages that come by default with this
version of R? If so, what versions of aroma should I use?

Best,
Michal Blazejczyk
Lead Developer
FlexArray

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Installing on R 2.8.1
parts:
Hi Michal,

it shouldn't be tedious at all - did you follow the instructions?

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix")

URL: http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/download-install

That should install R.huge v0.1.6 as well, but if it for some reason
doesn't ,do:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbInstall("R.huge")

BTW, what is your sessionInfo()?

Yes, aroma.affymetrix v1.0.0 works well with R 2.8.1 and the "release"
version of Bioconductor.

Cheers

Henrik
